rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for inferring or guessing from incomplete evidence.

example.english: They still haven't replied to me; I speculate that they may still be angry.
example.traditional: 佢咁耐都唔覆我，我估佢可能仲嬲緊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 ngo5 gu2 keoi5 ho2 nang4 zung6 niu5 gan2

rows.note: Use this when the risky speculation specifically involves buying and selling shares, property, or other assets for profit.

example.english: Even with property prices so volatile, some people still borrow money to speculate in uncompleted flats.
example.traditional: 而家樓價咁波動，仲有人借錢炒賣樓花。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 lau4 gaa3 gam3 bo1 dung6 zung6 jau5 jan4 ze3 cin2 caau2 maai6 lau4 faa1
